meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 启用后,NanoClaw 不再走 OneCLI 网关,改为从 .env 读取 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 或 OAuth 令牌,以环境变量形式注入容器,供 Claude Agent SDK 直接使用。需要 .env 中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true。
howto.when: 当 .env 中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并重启服务后,在启动容器、组装环境变量时触发;未设置则该功能不生效。

say.text: 帮我启用 .env 原生凭据,关掉 OneCLI 网关
say.note: 会开启该标志并改写启动参数

say.text: 改用 Anthropic API key 作为凭据
say.note: 会写入 API key 并重启服务

howto.what_en: When enabled, NanoClaw stops using the OneCLI gateway and instead reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an OAuth token from .env, injecting them into the container as environment variables for the Claude Agent SDK. Requires NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true in .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env and the service is restarted, at container spawn while assembling env vars; otherwise it is a no-op.

say_en.text: Enable the .env native credentials and turn off the OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: Sets the flag and changes startup args.

say_en.text: I want to log in with my Claude subscription and configure CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
say_en.note: Runs claude setup-token and writes the token into .env.

say_en.text: Switch to an Anthropic API key for credentials.
say_en.note: Writes the API key and restarts the service.
